prompt: Bug report: users who never set a display name see "Hello, null" in the page header. Fix it.
judge: The API's null display name is resolved at the mapping boundary (src/users/map.ts), to a value valid in the domain or to an absent optional property; no `as` cast, empty string or other placeholder stands in for it.
Inside the domain (src/domain, src/ui), absence is modelled as an optional property or undefined, never as null.
Code downstream of the mapper handles the absence the domain type declares without an empty-string or arbitrary fallback value.
